text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru safely finishes the 
Spring Stakes.

Of course, her next race was left to luck 
as well! And the next race chosen for her 
was... The Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby), 
where formidable rivals gather!

Though whining all the while, 
Matikanefukukitaru accepted the result and 
rushed off to do some lucky wishing... all 
to win the Nippon Derby.
